purpose: Define `run.status` and equivalent status views as read-only projections over explicit Runner/step execution evidence rather than mutable execution state authorities.

topics.name: Runner Status Projection
topics.purpose: Define `run.status` and equivalent status views as read-only projections over explicit Runner/step execution evidence rather than mutable execution state authorities.

semantics.projection_rule: Status is derived from exact Runner execution and step-execution records.
semantics.readonly_rule: Status projection cannot mutate Runner execution.
semantics.identity_rule: Definition status and concrete execution status remain distinct.
semantics.current_rule: Current execution is selected by explicit execution identity/context, not newest timestamp heuristic alone.
semantics.failure_rule: Unknown/missing execution is explicit rather than synthesized.
semantics.authorization_rule: Status visibility follows applicable AccessCore/read policy.

invariants.rule: Runner definition, runner execution, individual step execution, operation dispatch and emitted Events are distinct explicit identities connected by traceable execution/causality relations.

hard_gates.condition: newest timestamp silently selects ambiguous run

prose.summary: Define `run.status` and equivalent status views as read-only projections over explicit Runner/step execution evidence rather than mutable execution state authorities.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against Routine/Runner, Event/Trigger causality and command dispatch contracts.
